result.description: Cloud messaging platform; developers get a free HTTP Bot API (bot tokens from BotFather) and the MTProto Telegram API/TDLib for building full clients.
result.auth_detail: Bot API: per-bot token from @BotFather embedded in URL (api.telegram.org/bot<token>/METHOD). MTProto user API: api_id/api_hash from my.telegram.org plus user phone-code login (session string). Login Widget / Web Login exists for authenticating users on websites, but is not OAuth2 for API access.
result.access_detail: Gate audit: (1) No app review, listing, or partner status. Anyone creates a bot via @BotFather and the token works immediately for any chats that message the bot; end users do not need to approve an app. User-account API needs own api_id (free, one per phone number); Terms say api_id must be your own, with monitoring and ban risk for abuse. (2) No paid plan: API is free of charge. Only optional paid broadcasts (above 30 msg/s) cost Stars. Caveat: for a Composio-style multi-tenant toolkit, users each supply their own bot token (simple), so no gate.
result.api_notes: Bot API is HTTPS JSON with 100+ methods (messages, media, polls, chats/admin, inline, payments, stickers, webhooks/getUpdates, Mini Apps). MTProto API (TDLib) gives full user-account coverage but is not REST. Rate limits: ~1 msg/s per chat, ~30 msg/s broadcast. Bots cannot initiate chats with users who haven't messaged them, and cannot read arbitrary chats.

evidence.quote: The Bot API is an HTTP-based interface created for developers keen on building bots for Telegram.
Each bot is given a unique authentication token
You will get basic addresses as well as the api_id and api_hash parameters required for user authorization.
You are welcome to use both APIs free of charge.
You must obtain your own api_id for your application.
A Telegram integration for Claude, Cursor, and other MCP-compatible clients.
This API allows you to connect bots to our system.
